Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd. (ROHL), through its subsidiary Regenta Hotels Private Limited, has launched Regenta Magnus, Pune, strengthening the Group’s presence in Maharashtra. Located in Viman Nagar, the contemporary upscale hotel is positioned to cater to business and leisure travellers.

The property currently features 66 rooms and suites, comprising 62 Club Rooms spanning 380 sq ft and four Executive Suites measuring 750 sq. ft. An additional 39 rooms are scheduled to be added by December 2026, taking the hotel’s total inventory to 105 keys.

Dining facilities include Mellan, a restaurant serving global flavours and regional favourites, and Cocobrisa, an all-day cafe, kitchen and bar. The hotel also features a rooftop infinity swimming pool with city views and three banquet halls, Magnova I, II and III, with a combined theatre-style capacity of up to 192 guests.
The property offers airport and metro connectivity, high-speed Wi-Fi, workspaces and 24-hour amenities for corporate and leisure travellers.

Chander K. Baljee, CMD, Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd., said: “The launch of Regenta Magnus, Pune is an important milestone in our continued expansion across key business and leisure destinations in India. With this property, we are delighted to offer the warmth of Royal Orchid hospitality combined with contemporary elegance, making Regenta Magnus the preferred choice for discerning guests in Pune.”

Keshav Baljee, Whole-time Director, Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd., added: “Regenta Magnus represents our focused approach to growing in high-potential urban micro-markets. Pune’s Viman Nagar corridor offers excellent connectivity and a vibrant catchment. We are excited to strengthen our presence in Maharashtra and look forward to delivering memorable stays as we scale towards 105 keys.”
